name: BMW X6 M
description: The BMW X6 M delivers the performance of a sports car with the presence of an SUV. Muscular, dynamic, and luxurious — it’s made to dominate any road.

reviews.name: Oleksandr K.
reviews.text: Insane power! Drives like a sportscar, looks like a king.

reviews.name: Svitlana R.
reviews.text: The mix of performance and comfort is just perfect.

name: BMW X5 xDrive45e
description: The BMW X5 xDrive45e combines hybrid efficiency with traditional BMW power. Perfect for drivers who want luxury and sustainability in one package.

reviews.name: Liliia H.
reviews.text: Silent drive in EV mode and smooth acceleration — love it.

name: BMW X3 M Competition
description: The BMW X3 M Competition is a compact performance SUV that delivers thrilling agility and the pure spirit of M in a versatile design.

reviews.name: Roman D.
reviews.text: Feels like an M3 on stilts. Quick and sharp!

reviews.name: Olena V.
reviews.text: Perfect daily car with incredible performance.

name: BMW X1 xDrive30e
description: The BMW X1 xDrive30e is the ideal compact hybrid SUV, offering efficiency, style, and the agility typical of BMW’s smallest SAV.

reviews.name: Maksym L.
reviews.text: Great city car — small outside, big inside!

reviews.name: Iryna P.
reviews.text: Love the hybrid system. Very smooth transition between modes.

name: BMW X2 M35i
description: The BMW X2 M35i brings sporty looks and performance to the compact crossover segment — bold, fast, and fun to drive.

reviews.name: Yevhen S.
reviews.text: Looks sporty and drives like a hot hatch — love it!

reviews.name: Kateryna Z.
reviews.text: Fun and practical at the same time. Great daily SUV.

name: BMW X4 M40i
description: The BMW X4 M40i combines coupe-like design with the practicality of an SUV, delivering sporty handling and a premium interior.

reviews.name: Andrii M.
reviews.text: Sleek and sporty. The driving dynamics are spot on.

reviews.name: Daria T.
reviews.text: Love the coupe style! Comfort meets performance.

name: BMW X5 M Competition
description: The BMW X5 M Competition is the definition of luxury and power in the SUV world. Uncompromising performance and unmatched comfort.

reviews.name: Yaroslav G.
reviews.text: Huge power, stunning quality. Worth every bit.

reviews.name: Sofiia V.
reviews.text: Incredible SUV — fast, luxurious, and surprisingly agile.

name: BMW XM Label Red
description: The BMW XM Label Red is the most powerful M model ever built — bold hybrid performance and ultimate luxury combined in one extraordinary SUV.

reviews.name: Denys K.
reviews.text: Unreal power! Hybrid technology done right.

reviews.name: Viktoria H.
reviews.text: Massive, luxurious, and lightning-fast — it’s art on wheels.

name: BMW iX xDrive50
description: The all-electric BMW iX xDrive50 offers futuristic design, high efficiency, and instant torque — redefining what an electric SUV can be.

reviews.name: Oksana N.
reviews.text: Silent, smooth, and futuristic. A glimpse of the future.

reviews.name: Andrii B.
reviews.text: Electric power with true BMW soul — love the iX!
